title: Scaling Distributed Systems with Go
description: Explore patterns and practices for building resilient, high-throughput distributed systems using the Go programming language. This talk covers concurrency primitives, service discovery, and fault tolerance.

title: Modern Frontend: Beyond Frameworks
description: Deep dive into web standards, browser APIs, and performance optimization techniques that help you build faster websites regardless of the framework you use.

title: Architecting for Security in the Modern Era
description: Learn how to integrate security into every stage of your development lifecycle. We'll discuss Zero Trust architecture, secret management, and automated security scanning.

title: Pragmatic Machine Learning for Software Engineers
description: You don't need a PhD to leverage AI. This talk shows how to integrate pre-trained models and building simple classification systems into your existing applications.

title: The Future of Serverless Computing
description: An overview of the evolving serverless landscape, focusing on Edge computing, cold-start optimizations, and the move towards stateful serverless functions.

title: Building Accessible and Inclusive Interfaces
description: Accessibility is not a feature; it's a fundamental requirement. Discover how to create digital experiences that work for everyone using ARIA roles, semantic HTML, and thoughtful design.
